title: Top selling products with CTE
statement_markdown: Return the three products with the greatest total quantity ordered. Return product name and total quantity, highest total first.

examples.explanation: This output comes from the visible sample data.

hints: Aggregate quantity per product_id before joining names.
Put the aggregate in a CTE, join it to products, then apply ORDER BY and LIMIT.
explanation: The CTE reduces order_items to one total per product. Joining afterward attaches readable names without grouping every product column. A common mistake is limiting raw order rows before aggregation. A derived table could work too, but the CTE makes the two stages clear.
reference_solution: WITH product_sales AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id) SELECT p.name, ps.total FROM product_sales ps JOIN products p ON p.id = ps.product_id ORDER BY ps.total DESC, p.name LIMIT 3
